limits: The source base is 42d508b46dc7e7cda7efe3c6bfd4396450afedef; the graph remains ca2f92b2887c711d152cbfd7e3615c3264a875a8. This is deliberately not presented as a fresh 42d index.

For the five-file staged patch, three pre-existing source files have identical blobs in both bases; the two added files do not exist in either baseline. Engine loop, worker, shared canonical JSON and queue delivery identity are also identical across graph base, source base and worktree.
The added approval helper and its new test file have no baseline graph nodes. The helper adds nine named production declarations: four constants and five callables.

The inherited web module is byte-identical to source base 42d and outside this staged patch. Compared with graph base ca2f, it adds ten named declarations including assertSearchActive; those declarations are not reflected by the old graph.
Named-declaration AST analysis covers the approval helper and inherited web module only. Anonymous callback additions, test declarations and type-member properties are not exhaustively enumerated.
The staged result measures indexed symbols overlapping changed ranges. Its medium rating does not exhaustively assess newly added code or fill the baseline graph gaps.
The affected process LoadApprovalContinuation -> Encode belongs to the graph baseline; the staged approval call sites use canonicalApprovalParams instead.

Compare main covers the whole reconciled branch and five-file patch, not just this patch. Its symbol listing is capped at one thousand while changed_count is 6896; affected process listing contains 501.
